english: In the plane $z=0$, the lines $x-y+1=0$, $x+2y-11=0$ and $2x-y-7=0$ form a triangle $ABC$, where $A$ is the point of intersection of the second and the third line, $B$ that of the first and the third line, and $C$ that of the first and the second line. A point $D$, with positive $z$-coordinate, lies on the line through the origin parallel to the vector $2\hat{i}-\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$, and the volume of the tetrahedron $ABCD$ is $10$. Then the perpendicular distance of the vertex $A$ from the plane $BCD$ is
hindi: समतल $z=0$ में रेखाएँ $x-y+1=0$, $x+2y-11=0$ तथा $2x-y-7=0$ एक त्रिभुज $ABC$ बनाती हैं, जहाँ $A$ दूसरी तथा तीसरी रेखा का प्रतिच्छेदन बिन्दु है, $B$ पहली तथा तीसरी रेखा का, तथा $C$ पहली तथा दूसरी रेखा का प्रतिच्छेदन बिन्दु है। धनात्मक $z$-निर्देशांक वाला एक बिन्दु $D$ मूलबिन्दु से होकर सदिश $2\hat{i}-\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$ के समान्तर रेखा पर स्थित है, तथा चतुष्फलक $ABCD$ का आयतन $10$ है। तब समतल $BCD$ से शीर्ष $A$ की लम्बवत् दूरी है
solution_full: $D$ is on the line through $O$ parallel to $(2,-1,2)$: $D=(2k,-k,2k)$ with $2k>0$. Its height above the base plane $z=0$ is $2k$.
Volume $=\dfrac13\times$ base area $\times$ height: $\dfrac13\cdot\dfrac{15}{2}\cdot2k=5k=10\Rightarrow k=2$, so $D=(4,-2,4)$.
Taking $BCD$ as the base, $10=\dfrac13\cdot\dfrac{45}{2}\cdot d$, so $d=\dfrac{60}{45}=\dfrac43$.
Check: the plane $BCD$ is $4x-4y-7z+4=0$ (it contains $B$, $C$, $D$); for $A$: $\dfrac{|20-12-0+4|}{\sqrt{16+16+49}}=\dfrac{12}{9}=\dfrac43$.
originality_note: New: the base is given only by three lines of the xy-plane (2D area of a triangle), the apex is located on a given line through the origin by the volume, and the volume is reused with a different face as base to give an altitude (way 5). Closest known: volume of a tetrahedron with given vertices, or altitude from a vertex. Different because: the apex is not given and must be fixed by the volume, and the 2D area formula and the 3D cross-product area are both needed.

concept_use.Questions based on tetrahedron: Volume = (1/3) base area x height used twice: with base ABC to fix D, then with base BCD to get the altitude from A.
concept_use.Area of triangle: Vertices from the three lines and the area 15/2 of triangle ABC by the coordinate (determinant) formula; area of face BCD as half the length of a cross product.

stem_review: Read as a student: every point, line and plane is introduced before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently with sympy and numpy, is unique and equals the Answer Plan; the options have one form and exactly one is correct. Named which pair of lines gives each vertex, and fixed the sign of the z-coordinate of D so that D is unique. Changed: added 'with positive z-coordinate'.
key_step: Fixing D from the volume using the 2D base area, then using the same volume with face BCD as base.
justification: Four linked stages (vertices, 2D area, apex from volume, 3D face area and altitude) with two area formulas; an average Advanced chain. Like the 3D foot-and-area work of 2026-P2-Q7 (L3).
